title: AITA for shouting at my dad to get out my room because I have exams tomorrow?
question: AITA for shouting at my dad to get out my room because I have exams tomorrow?
body:
Where I live, Adelaide, AU, year 11 exams start tomorrow. These are important to my family, who really like acting condescending and disappointed if I get less than an A-. They don’t matter at all and don’t even count towards my overall grade, but I still try hard. This is for two reasons:

1. I still like doing well at school. I have a kind of unearned reputation as being ‘smart’ because I’m one of the few who actually try.

2. I don’t wanna take the shit from my family for getting a B.

So, with exams beginning tomorrow, I need to study (I’m writing this in my 30min break after tea). Meanwhile, I still have the rest of my life moving around me.  This includes driving lessons, organising stuff with friends, chores, and dealing with my dads issues. That last one is the killer. I love him, and he needs someone to talk to about his problems, but it really can’t be me, especially right before exams. He has PTSD and life hasn’t treated him well. Most nights he’ll burst into my room without knocking and tell me something random from his past before leaving, only to come back in 10 minutes later to continue the story. It kills me because I love him and want to help, but I always have to try and subtly get him to stop because I have to work. It doesn’t ever solve the issue and I generally just end up having to catch up during school time during my lunch times and stuff. That’s not an option with exams, so I ended up telling him to “fuck off” on the third time he in in about an hour. He was really take aback and dinner was really awkward cis he was literally holding back tears and made sure he had a good shout at me over the incident.

I really should have given some more obvious hints before bursting, but I’m kinda stressed and I’m just not sure anymore. What are you guys’ thoughts?
